newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Goldfields sells Wau project in PNG.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Goldfields sells Wau project in PNG.

text.p: Goldfields Ltd said on Monday it had sold its Wau gold project in Papua New Guinea to Australian Gold Fields NL for A$27.5 million.
Goldfields said the payment consisted of A$17.5 million in cash and A$10 million in redeemable unsecured notes convertible into five million Australian Gold shares.
The company also said it would receive a 2.5 percent royalty on the first 500,000 ounces of gold production and four percent thereafter.
Goldfields has a 25 percent stake in PNG's Porgera gold mine, as well as operations in Western Australia and Tasmania.
Australian Gold said separately that the Wau project consisted of two gold deposits called Hamata and Kerimenge and several prospects located 12 kilometres to the southwest.
Wau is located about 250 kilometres north of the PNG capital of Port Moresby in the Morobe province.
The company said Hamata had inferred resources of 9.4 million tonnes at 3.2 g/t containing 970,000 ounces of gold, using a 1.0 g/t cut-off.
Hamata is located about five kms north of the Hidden Valley gold project which Australian Gold is also in the process of acquiring.
Kerimenge is located about seven kms northeast of Hidden Valley and had inferred resources of 18.4 million tonnes at 2.0 g/t containing about 1.18 million ounces of gold using a 1.0 g/t cut-off.
Australian Gold said the Wau project is at an advanced exploration stage with plans for further exploration and the completion of a bankable feasibility study.
It said the Wau project will be merged with the Hidden Valley project to form a project with resources containing about 5.6 million ounces of gold and 63.6 million ounces of silver.
